nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠Brunei's Ministry of Health (#MoH) confirmed that there has been no abnormal increase in Human metapneumovirus (#HMPV) cases in the country. 
In 2024, 45 cases were recorded, a decline from 88 cases in 2023.

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠The MoH emphasized that #HMPV is not a new disease and typically causes mild symptoms in healthy individuals, though it can be severe in vulnerable groups like young children, the elderly, and those with weakened immune systems.
#Brunei #hMPV #outbreak @CDCgov

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠Preventive measures such as frequent handwashing, wearing masks, and avoiding close contact with symptomatic individuals are advised. 
#Brunei #hMPV #outbreak @CDCgov

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠Meanwhile, #Brunei’s comprehensive surveillance system for influenza-like illnesses (ILI) and severe acute respiratory infections (#SARI) indicates no significant increase in cases as of early January 2025, aligning with typical seasonal trends.
#Brunei #hMPV #outbreak @CDCgov

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠HMPV and ILI cases in Brunei remain stable, with no notable surges reported. 
The Ministry of Health continues to monitor these infections closely in collaboration with regional and global partners, ensuring preparedness and timely updates for public #health.
#Brunei #hMPV
